contract.  Return one complete TopModule implementation.

tasks.prompt: At rising clk reset sets wave high and phase zero. At later edges the required repeated wave samples are 1,0,0,0,1 starting on the first post-reset edge. Preserve this exact five-cycle alignment, not just the two-fifths duty ratio. All inputs are binary unless explicitly stated. Observe sequential outputs immediately after the active rising edge. The named reset is synchronous, active high and has priority, unless the contract explicitly says otherwise. Unspecified illegal states are outside scope.
tasks.reference: module TopModule(input clk,reset,output reg wave);reg[2:0]phase;always@(posedge clk)if(reset)begin phase<=0;wave<=1;end else begin if(phase==4)phase<=0;else phase<=phase+1;wave<=(phase==4||phase==0);end endmodule
tasks.target: module TopModule(input clk,reset,output reg wave);reg[2:0]phase;always@(posedge clk)if(reset)begin phase<=0;wave<=1;end else begin if(phase==4)phase<=0;else phase<=phase+1;wave<=(phase==4);end endmodule

tasks.adjacent: module TopModule(input clk,reset,valid,input[7:0]data,output reg payload_valid,output reg[7:0]payload);reg in_frame,count;always@(posedge clk)begin if(reset)begin in_frame<=0;count<=0;payload_valid<=0;payload<=0;end else begin payload_valid<=0;if(valid)begin if(!in_frame&&data==8'h7e)begin in_frame<=1;count<=0;end else begin payload_valid<=1;payload<=data;if(in_frame)begin if(count)in_frame<=0;else count<=1;end end end end end endmodule
tasks.interface: module TopModule(input clk,reset,valid,input[7:0]data,output reg payload_valid,output reg[7:0]payload); endmodule
tasks.prompt: Synchronous reset clears payload_valid and payload and enters search mode. Only accepted valid bytes affect framing. In search, 0x7e starts a frame and is not emitted; the next two accepted bytes are payload including any 0x7e value. Emit each at its acceptance edge with payload_valid high, then resume search. payload_valid clears on nonpayload edges and payload holds. All inputs are binary unless explicitly stated. Observe sequential outputs immediately after the active rising edge. The named reset is synchronous, active high and has priority, unless the contract explicitly says otherwise. Unspecified illegal states are outside scope.
tasks.reference: module TopModule(input clk,reset,valid,input[7:0]data,output reg payload_valid,output reg[7:0]payload);reg in_frame,count;always@(posedge clk)begin if(reset)begin in_frame<=0;count<=0;payload_valid<=0;payload<=0;end else begin payload_valid<=0;if(valid)begin if(!in_frame)begin if(data==8'h7e)begin in_frame<=1;count<=0;end end else begin payload_valid<=1;payload<=data;if(count)in_frame<=0;else count<=1;end end end end endmodule
tasks.target: module TopModule(input clk,reset,valid,input[7:0]data,output reg payload_valid,output reg[7:0]payload);reg in_frame,count;always@(posedge clk)begin if(reset)begin in_frame<=0;count<=0;payload_valid<=0;payload<=0;end else begin payload_valid<=0;if(valid)begin if(data==8'h7e)begin in_frame<=1;count<=0;end else if(in_frame)begin payload_valid<=1;payload<=data;if(count)in_frame<=0;else count<=1;end end end end endmodule
